description: Tarifs TGV INOUI et OUIGO is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Prix plein tarif des trains TGV INOUI et OUIGO. Une fourchette de prix (prix minimum, prix maximum) est affichée pour chaque origine-destination et classe tarifaire. Les prix des trains TGV INOUI sont en vigueur à partir du 01/04/2026 et ceux des trains OUIGO à partir du 02/01/2026. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Tarifs voyageurs. Its keywords are tarif, TGV, OUIGO. The portal shows 2026-03-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
